name: Afterflow
description: a predictive input cheat that fixes your early clicks and makes them accurate, with customizable UI colors and a polished control panel.

terminal-enabled.name: enable terminal
terminal-enabled.description: show the terminal button in the afterflow control panel

keybinds-title.name: keybinds
keybinds-title.description: change geodes keybinding anytime for afterflow

keybind-terminal.name: control panel
keybind-terminal.description: open or close the afterflow control panel

deep-title.name: deep scan
deep-title.description: simulate the whole level in place and keep a map of every reachable state for the buffer

keybind-deep.name: deep scan
keybind-deep.description: start a deep scan of the current level, press again to stop and save

keybind-deep-pause.name: pause deep scan
keybind-deep-pause.description: pause or resume a running deep scan

deep-beam.name: beam width
deep-beam.description: branches kept per tick. more is slower and covers more states

deep-budget.name: frame budget (ms)
deep-budget.description: time per frame the scan may spend at max speed

deep-swarm.name: draw branches
deep-swarm.description: draw the branch swarm while scanning

deep-use.name: use scan map
deep-use.description: let the buffer judge clicks with the saved map of the level

deep-align.name: alignment margin
deep-align.description: ticks a saved click may move toward the middle of the window the map confirms

ui-primary-color.name: primary color
ui-primary-color.description: primary gradient color for the panel

ui-secondary-color.name: secondary color
ui-secondary-color.description: secondary gradient color for the panel

ui-surface-color.name: surface color
ui-surface-color.description: background color of the panel card

ui-text-color.name: text color
ui-text-color.description: color used for all panel text

ui-glow.name: glow
ui-glow.description: draw a soft accent glow behind the panel

ui-panel-scale.name: panel scale
ui-panel-scale.description: adjust the overall size of the control panel

ui-font-scale.name: font scale
ui-font-scale.description: adjust the text size in the control panel

mobile-floating-button.name: floating af button
mobile-floating-button.description: also show the draggable af button on screen. the pause menu button is always there
